_comment: End-to-end golden scenarios captured from an INDEPENDENT public simulator. Unlike wage/withholding.test.ts (whose expectations derive from our own dataset), these numbers were produced by someone else's implementation of the 2026 rules, so they test that the engine APPLIES the tables the way a real payroll calculation does — table-to-category mapping, the §5.h reduction, and rounding.
method: Simulator state is encoded in a base64 JSON `data=` query param; each scenario was driven by URL and the rendered result read from the page.
notes: Meal allowance zeroed (daily_meal_card_value: 0, meal_card_days: 0) and duodécimos off, so the comparison is base salary only — matching the engine's Phase 1 scope.
The simulator's displayed 'Retenção IRS' line floors to whole euros (e.g. 168.17 renders as 168,00), so `net` is the field compared; it is computed from the unrounded withholding.

mealScenarios pin the 2026 per-day ceilings (10,46 card / 6,15 cash) empirically: the at-ceiling cases leave the Segurança Social base at 11% of base salary, and the over-ceiling cases move it by exactly the excess.

irsJovemScenarios confirm the art. 99.º-F n.º 4 mechanism empirically: at 1 500 € in year 2 the simulator withholds 42 €, which is the full salary's effective rate (11,21 %) on the non-exempt 375 € — not the rate the 375 € would attract on its own (which would be zero).

mealScenarios.note: card exactly at the ceiling — fully exempt, SS base untouched
card above the ceiling — 33,88 € excess enters both bases
cash exactly at the ceiling — fully exempt
cash above the ceiling — 40,70 € excess enters both bases

irsJovemScenarios._comment: Captured from the sibling IRS Jovem simulator (simulador-irs-jovem). Its displayed rate is rounded to 2 dp, so its net can sit up to ~0,70 € from an unrounded calculation; `tolerance` records what each case is asserted within.

cases.note: year 1 — 100 % exempt, no withholding at all
75 % exempt; rate from the full 1 500 €, levied on 375 €
55 × IAS ceiling bites: exemption capped at 2 110,15 € not 2 250 €
ceiling bites hard — without it the net would be 4 871,60 €
duodécimos are exempt income too, at the same share
